## Description

Clinic side: search help first, raise a request with category and description, warning not to include patient details, screenshots blurred where patient data appears, app version and recent errors attached. Console side: inbox with SLA timer, assignee, public replies and internal notes, 'request support access' that needs the owner's approval, lasts 60 minutes and shows no patient records. Support hours and urgent-outage line shown.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a screenshot shows patient data, when it is attached, then the patient data is blurred before storage.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given support, when asks for access, then nothing is visible until the owner approves and it ends after 60 minutes.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a request breaches its SLA, when time passes, then it is flagged to the team lead.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
